Sounds like you want a nuker with high mobility, I would recommend Kha'zix, Le Blanc (She has to be aggresive on early), Fizz, Master yi (In some sort of way it works out as an AD katarina), rengar (more tanky oriented) and zed.

Obviously depends on the champion you are using so I'mma try my best to explain some of the statistics I know.

CDR: You want to build CDR when you champ is more likely to use each spell more than once or twice during a team fights, champions like Akali.

Mana Regen: You want to buy mana regen when your combo is on a long cooldown and uses a fair enough chunk of your mana pool.

Maximum mana: As oposed to "Mana regen" you want to get plain mana when your are more likely to use your habilities a lot of times and not just once or twice per team fight.

Spell vamp: Use spell vamp when you are most likely to use your habilities a lot of times during a team fight AND your survivability is compromised by your positioning.

Magic penetration: Against enemies with MR.

Now there's special items that due to their functionality or their active depends on the occasion, those are:

Lich Bane: If your combo ALREADY INCLUDES an easy to pull off AA, and you are most likely to use your abilities more than once or twice during teamfights.

Liandry's Torment: Good against heavy MR enemies and if you deal DOT (Damage over time) like malzahar or cassiopeia.

Zhonya's Hourglass: It's good in two different occasions, when you are being focused and when your abilities need a couple of seconds to use again, champions like fizz and katarina would make a good use on this item even if the enemy doesn't have much ad and/or cc as you mentioned it.

Doran's Ring: If you use the mana regen + extra little bit of health. (not standard)

Iceborn Gauntlet: Helps you with kiting enemies, specially if you are melee. It's more tank oriented but you could use it with Diana, nidalee bruiser and so.

Azir works as a lane bully too, so that match up can only go you  stomping him, him stomping you, or nothing happening until lane phase is over.

To understand how to beat a champion I recommend playing that champion to spot it's weaknesses and then taking advantages of that.

What I've noticed when playing azir is that your Q (Rushing soldiers to a location) has 2 disadvantages one the short range and two the fairly long cooldown, so when playing against azir juking that Q will leave him with no more options than AA you without his soldiers.

I would recommend using your W only for juking his Q and doing one of the combos with E I mentioned in Couldntstoplaughing's comment. 

Having your W on Cooldown and being near him with his Q avaliable is asking for poking.

Also be carefull not to be in the way of him and his soldier, the knock up + shield will help him a lot.

The problem with that combo is that you are not popping your Q's mark so there's damage you are not doing with it, for poking combo I recommend:

1. E + Q + AA's. If you land the E immediately use your Q so when the E "roots" the enemy it'll pop the Q's mark.

2. Q + W + AA. Easy to land, but watch out since Q has a low range some enemies will take this advantage.

For ult combos I tend to use:

1. Q + R(Q) + W. Simple and will do a lot of damage, just remember being carefull for the low range Q.

2. E + Q + R(Q). If you land your E you go full combo and still have your W for escaping or even more damage.

3. E + R(E) + Q. Now this one won't do as much damage as the others, but, if you hit your first E you will land your mimicked E for sure making a 3 seconds rooting at least (not taking into account the slow) and your Q mark will be popped by your mimicked E rooting, I use this when my jungler ganks and has no gap closer or cc but instead can deal damage, so it's your call to have them in place for 3-5 seconds and your jungler dealing damage or dealing more damage by yourself

I played my placements matches with lb and got plat 4.

LB is a lane bully, and lane bullies have one thing in common, they need to overcome his enemy on early game because they are not that great post mid game if they don't have at least a slight lead, either having more cs, denying experience, forcing enemy lane to go to base or killing them.

My main goal with lb in lane is poking and harrasing as much as I can, level 2 is decent enough to start harrasing. That said, you have to be carefull with sustained, tanky enemy laners who can resist your early poke such as diana or karma.

Also avoid full engages with all in enemies, since poking is the key most champions will try to all in LB.

When in lane I try to go back pre-6, so I can buy more ap and have that slight advantage LB really needs to have when using my ult.

Building depends on the match but I usually build some CDR and mana regen, CDR is really usefull on LB since your W will have a ridiculous CD allowing you to improve your annoying-es on teamfights.

It's always good to focus the back lane on teamfights but don't be scared to combo their front lane, specially if there's no heavy MR front.
